what_happened: Scene: layout/style 7, wooden board left of the robot, red-rimmed plate with a large steak (steak_6) on the right; the steak rests tilted ~35 deg against the plate rim from the start. Stage 0 was clean: a close on air at 206 in the drawer, then a real grasp at 335 (knife lifted from 347, 0.30 m), carried left and released flat on the board at 459 (0.06 m from the board centre, stayed); stage 0 complete 459 (median 486). Stage 1: went to the plate (~560) and closed on the near edge of the steak at 596 (width 0.016); the wrist view shows only a sliver of steak between the finger tips; it rose 0.5 cm and slipped out by ~620, after which the fingers were fully shut (0.002). With the gripper still closed it carried on to the board and did an empty 'place' over the knife (648-720), then wandered up and around the paper-towel holder and above the plate 800-1400 with the gripper closed the whole time (624-1440). At 1440 it opened over the board, went back to the plate, and at 1563 closed on the steak edge again (touch 1569-1577, lift 0) when the episode ended at 1600.
causal_chain: knife placed 459 (normal) -> fingertip grasp on the edge of a tilted steak at 596, lift 0.005 m, slipped ~620 -> continued empty to the board 648-720 -> wandered with closed gripper 800-1440 -> second fingertip touch on the steak 1563-1577 without lift -> timeout 1600, meat still on plate (0.66 m from board)
self_recovery: One late retry: reopened at 1440 and returned to the steak, closing at 1563 on its edge again without lifting; ran out of time. No retry right after the slip.
